correctness.rationale: The finite one-deletion and non-overlap conditions are fully quantified. The exact group-cover certificate gives 16|C|<=98 after a valid ternary normal-form reduction and an explicit six-word set attains it. Two separately implemented exact programs reconstruct the 72 optimal codebooks and seven complete symmetry orbits; the complete n=2..5 table is enumerated without Monte Carlo or floating-point decisions. Both executable checks returned VERIFY_OK and ALTERNATE_OK from supplied files.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Prior upper bounds on the larger non-overlap family do not give the stronger restricted optimum. A binary calculation cannot determine a ternary codebook census merely by inclusion or alphabet embedding; the direction of that implication is wrong. The separate Hamming detection maximum 9 is also only a weak upper bound for this class. An exact upper bound for correcting two deletions does not upper-bound the size of codes correcting only one deletion, so numerical equality of published two-deletion capacity 6 gives no implication.
